title: Mapping pairs and reducing totals
description: You can follow values and squares into a pair of sums.

steps.description: You import reduce and create the list 1 through 5. These values supply the map operation.
map turns each x into the pair (x, x squared). list collects those transformed pairs in mapped_data.

steps.question: What does the reduction keep in each position of its accumulated pair?
steps.answer: It keeps the sum of original values in position zero and the sum of squares in position one.

steps.description: You see (15, 55) printed. This code combines all mapped pairs directly in one local reduction.
